name: Athens Blanket
description: Luxury doesn’t have to be heavy on the pocket. The Athens Striped Blanket is designed for those who love a polished, hotel-like look without overspending.
detailedDescription: Featuring refined solid stripes and a soft luminous finish, it instantly elevates your sofa, bedroom, or lounge corner. Crafted in a super shiny, smooth-touch fabric, it reflects light beautifully, creating a rich and polished finish. Lightweight, it offers comfortable warmth without feeling bulky — perfect for everyday luxury. Available in graceful, contemporary shades that complement both neutral and bold interiors.
careInstructions: wash in cold/lukewarm water(delicate in washing machine)1-2 in a season, mild detergent, dry flat(air dry in sun)avoid heat, store in plastic bags /cover

name: Nazakat Blanket
description: Gracefully refined and exquisitely detailed, the Nazakat Blanket is a statement of timeless luxury.

Perfect for those who appreciate classic detailing and luxurious comfort, the Nazakat Blanket blends warmth, artistry, and refined charm in one exceptional piece.
